message: Thank you for always staying after class to explain lessons again. I understood Calculus because of you.
Please add more vegetarian options and fix the long lines during lunch break.
You made Physics fun even though I used to hate the subject. I'll miss your jokes during exams.
The wifi in the library is so slow, it was hard to do research there. Please upgrade it for future students.
Four years here changed me. I just wish there were more mental health resources available for students who are struggling.

suggestion: The student appreciates the teacher's efforts.
